summary: MarketBeat interviews Anthony Durkz of Quantum BioPharma on the FDA approval process and what biotech investors need to know. Key framework: Phase 1 tests safety/tolerability (highest risk, longest wait, dilution risk from further raises), Phase 2 is the efficacy read where most value is built, and Phase 3 carries roughly ~90% commercialization odds once reached. Durkz stresses funding runway (his company says funded through 2027), addressable market size (cites MS therapeutic market projected >$38B by 2030 per Grand View Research), and lack of competition as due-diligence pillars. He also discusses his own company's MS drug candidate entering Phase 2 (with ThermoFisher partnership; ~$27M market cap), framing Phase 3 as the window where big-pharma partnerships and acquisitions typically arrive. No explicit BUY/HOLD/SELL/AVOID call is made by MarketBeat in this video; the guest is a company insider discussing his own trial.
title: If You Don't Understand the FDA, You Don't Understand Biotech Stocks (Industry Expert Explains)
